candidateFindings.title: Hardcoded Internal API Token in Server Configuration
candidateFindings.description: A sensitive API token is hardcoded in source control, allowing unauthorized API access if repo is exposed.
candidateFindings.remediation: Load secrets strictly from environment variables (e.g. process.env.INTERNAL_API_TOKEN).

candidateFindings.title: Arbitrary File Read via Path Traversal in /download
candidateFindings.description: Unsanitized query parameter "file" is joined directly with directory path, allowing ../ traversal outside public folder.
candidateFindings.remediation: Validate resolved path with realpath and enforce that target starts with authorized root directory.

candidateFindings.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in /webhook
candidateFindings.description: The webhook endpoint accepts arbitrary user-controlled URLs without validating against private IP ranges or metadata endpoints.
candidateFindings.remediation: Implement an allowlist of target domains and enforce SSRF blocking for RFC 1918 and cloud metadata IP addresses.

candidateFindings.title: Remote Command Injection in Diagnostics Ping Endpoint
candidateFindings.description: Host parameter is concatenated directly into system shell without sanitization, allowing arbitrary command execution via metacharacters (; && |).
candidateFindings.remediation: Avoid raw shell execution. Use execFile with explicit argument arrays or an allowlist regex for IP address input.
